description: Classifies a patient's dizziness into one of four categories — vestibular/vertigo, presyncope, disequilibrium, or nonspecific — using history, timing, triggers, and associated symptoms. Use when a patient presents with dizziness, giddiness, lightheadedness, feeling off-balance, spinning, or nearly blacking out and you need to determine the type before further workup.
